output.title: Deadline for a Prescriber to Schedule a Peer-to-Peer Review After a Denial
output.draft_text:
Q: How many days does a prescriber have to schedule a peer-to-peer review after a denial?

A: After a prior authorization or coverage request is denied, the prescriber has [number of days] [calendar/business] days from [the date of the denial / the date the denial notice is issued / the date the denial notice is received] to request a peer-to-peer review.

How the prescriber requests it: The prescriber or their office should contact [department or team name] at [phone number] / [fax number] / [portal or other method] to schedule the review. They should have [required information, e.g., member ID, case or reference number, drug name] ready.

Who conducts the review: The peer-to-peer discussion is held with [reviewer type, e.g., clinical pharmacist or medical director].

If the window has passed: If the prescriber misses the peer-to-peer deadline, [available options, e.g., submit a formal appeal or a new request], and the deadline for that option is [number of days] days from [triggering event].

Does a peer-to-peer affect the appeal deadline? [Yes/No - explain whether requesting a peer-to-peer pauses or extends the formal appeal timeframe.]

Exceptions: [Note any differences by plan type, line of business (e.g., Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid), state requirements, or urgent/expedited cases.]

Advocate tip: Tell the member or prescriber office the exact date the window closes, calculated from [triggering event], and document the call in [system name].

author_checklist: Confirm the number of days allowed to request or schedule a peer-to-peer review after a denial.
Confirm whether the window is counted in calendar days or business days.
Confirm the event that starts the clock (denial date, notice issue date, or notice receipt date).
Confirm whether the deadline is to request the review or to complete it.
Confirm the contact method(s), phone/fax numbers, and portal for scheduling.
Confirm the information the prescriber must provide when scheduling.
Confirm options available if the peer-to-peer window is missed, and their deadlines.
Confirm whether requesting a peer-to-peer pauses or extends the formal appeal deadline.
Confirm any variations by line of business, plan type, state regulation, or expedited cases.
Confirm the documentation system advocates should use.
Identify the source policy or contract document supporting each fact and obtain approval from the pharmacy/utilization management owner.
